full_prompt_en: This is a square black-and-white film photograph of an older man in dark glasses seated across a smoke-filled room. He occupies the left half of the frame, sitting back in a broad dark chair with one leg crossed and both hands gathered near his lap. A dark suit jacket, pale shirt, and narrow tie give his posture a formal weight. His light hair is brushed back, and his face turns toward someone opposite him, though the glasses conceal his eyes. On the right foreground, a second person is present only as a deep, soft silhouette of shoulder and head, creating a close frame around the seated man. Between them, a thick cloud of smoke curls upward, catching bright light and partly obscuring the shelves and framed details at the rear. A shaded lamp glows high on the left, making a pale cone above the man's head and giving the room a visible source of light. The back wall contains indistinct vertical and rectangular shapes rather than readable words. The man's face, cuffs, and chair edge emerge in silvery midtones; the foreground figure and room corners collapse toward black. Film grain, soft smoke, and uneven contrast keep the image candid and tactile. The seated posture is still, while the drifting haze supplies the only clear movement. The overall composition is conversational yet distant, its bright lamp and luminous smoke separating two dark human forms in a confined interior.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形黑白胶片照片，一名戴深色眼镜的年长男子坐在烟雾弥漫的房间另一侧。他占据画面左半部，靠在宽大的深色椅子里，一条腿交叠，双手收在膝部附近。深色西装外套、浅衬衫和细领带使姿态带有正式的重量。他的浅发向后梳理，脸转向对面的人，眼镜却遮住双眼。右侧前景中，第二人仅以头肩的深色柔软剪影出现，在坐着的男子周围形成贴近的框架。两人之间，浓烟向上卷起，接住亮光，并部分遮挡后方架子与框状细节。带灯罩的灯在左上发亮，在男子头顶上方形成浅色光锥，也为房间提供可见光源。后墙有不清楚的竖形与矩形，而非可读文字。男子面部、袖口和椅边以银灰中间调浮现；前景人物与房间角落则趋近黑色。胶片颗粒、柔软烟雾与不均匀反差让画面自然且有触感。坐姿安静，飘散的烟气提供唯一清楚的动态。整体构图带有交谈感却保持距离，明亮台灯和发光烟雾将两道深色人形分隔在狭窄室内。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photographic style relies on grain, smoke-softened edges, and a broad interval between silvery midtones and dense black. One practical light creates a local bright island, with luminous haze carrying that brightness into the surrounding dark. Near silhouettes remain unresolved, while selected interior planes and facial surfaces gain just enough clarity to establish depth. The frame is layered from a close dark obstruction through a lit middle zone to a soft rear field. Curved vapor breaks up the heavier rectangular masses and introduces a slow visual rhythm. Contrast is expressive but never clinically sharp; optical softness and film texture keep each tonal transition alive. The overall effect is intimate, candid, and slightly detached.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色摄影风格依靠颗粒、被烟气柔化的边缘，以及银灰中间调与浓黑之间的宽阔明度区间。一处实际灯光形成局部明亮区域，发光雾气又把这份亮度带入周围黑暗。近处剪影保持不清，选择性的内部平面与面部表面则获得足够清晰度，建立纵深。画面从贴近的深色遮挡，经过受光中层，延伸到柔软后景。弯曲蒸气打散较重的矩形块面，引入缓慢的视觉节奏。反差富于表现力，却从不过分锐利；光学柔化和胶片肌理使每一次明度过渡保持活力。整体效果亲密、自然，又略带疏离。
theme_en: An older man in sunglasses seated in a smoke-filled room

name: Jean-Luc Godard
